name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, you begin your path by communing with the earth spirits and earning an Earth Totem.
As a dwarf, you can join your people’s ties to stone and mountain with the shamanic path by communing with earth spirits in Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance shaman, you find elemental spiritualists offering guidance around Anvilmar, within Ironforge lands.

aliases: why do i need rough quartz
faq.answer: An earth spirit gives you rough quartz as proof of communion. Teo Hammerstorm uses it to make your Earth Totem.
faq.q: What is the Rough Quartz for?

faq.answer: Teo Hammerstorm is a mentor in Anvilmar, in Dun Morogh. He tests aspiring shaman by asking for proof of communion with the elements before making their totems.
Through Call of Earth, young shaman seek communion with the earth spirits and earn their first Earth Totem.
faq.q: What is the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: The earth spirit asks you to stay strong and patient as you seek wisdom. It teaches that small things can outlast others, and that true power comes through mutual respect with the earth.
faq.q: What does the earth spirit ask of the initiate?

aliases: where does call of earth take place
faq.answer: Anvilmar lies in Coldridge Valley, in Dun Morogh. Young dwarven initiates train there and commune with the surrounding mountains.

aliases: what does an earth totem do
faq.answer: A totem connects a shaman with the elemental spirits. The Earth Totem binds your will to the mountains’ steadfast strength and resilience.
faq.q: Why is the Earth Totem important?

sections.body: In Dun Morogh, young shaman begin their spiritual path by seeking the earth spirit and listening to its teachings. The spirit gives them rough quartz, a humble stone meant to become the heart of an Earth Totem. The rite calls for humility, patience, strength, and resolve. An initiate learns from the earth and does not measure worth by size.
sections.title: The Whispering Stone

sections.body: Teo Hammerstorm waits in Anvilmar for the initiate to bring back the rough quartz. He judges whether the mountain spirits have acknowledged them, and sends away anyone who arrives without the stone. Bring him the quartz, and he shapes it into an Earth Totem. The totem binds the young shaman to the strength of the world's roots.
sections.title: The Mountain's Favor

summary: Young shaman in Dun Morogh seek the earth spirits’ favor through Call of Earth. They carry rough quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar, where he shapes it into the heart of an Earth Totem.
